name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Adaptive Density Control
aliases: 3D Gaussian Splatting Adaptive Density Control — Opacity-Gradient Pruning
definition: A pruning strategy that removes unstable or low-contribution Gaussians by combining opacity gradients, opacity values, and training loss.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting Adaptive Density Control refines primitive sets by removing unstable or low-contribution Gaussians using per-pixel opacity gradients and training loss, distinguishing itself from methods relying solely on static opacity thresholds.
